properties.name: Feature: BRP Check Effects
properties.author: Kerry Harrison (sirkerry)
properties.description: Adds a CHECK effect keyword that applies a flat percentage bonus/penalty to Skill, Characteristic, and Power checks, filterable by name. Stock Basic Roleplaying has zero EffectManager usage anywhere in its own code - this is the first piece of CoreRPG's Effects system actually wired up to a BRP mechanic.

announcement.text: BRP Check Effects - Version 1.0 by sirkerry
